messages.content: 美國目前的基尼係數是多少？

function.name: finance_fetchGDP
function.description: Fetch the GDP of the given country in the given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The name of the country to get the GDP of.

year.description: The year to get the GDP of.

format.description: The format to return the data in. Default is 'USD'.

message.content:
截至 2023 年底（或 2024 年初）美國的基尼係數（不含稅收與轉移支付前）約為 **0.41**。  
如果考慮稅收與社會福利轉移後，基尼係數會下降到大約 **0.32**。  

這些數值來自 OECD（經濟合作與發展組織）和 World Bank（世界銀行）的最新統計，兩者都以「不含稅收與轉移支付」為基準，並以 2022 年或 2023 年的數據為基礎。若您需要更精確的年份或其他細節（例如不同州或族群的分布），請告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "美國目前的基尼係數是多少？" (What is the current Gini coefficient of the United States?). They want the Gini coefficient. We need to provide the latest available figure. The user didn't specify a year. We can provide the most recent estimate. According to OECD or World Bank, the US Gini coefficient (pre-tax and pre-transfer) is around 0.41 (2022). The US Gini coefficient (post-tax and transfer) is lower, around 0.32. The user likely wants the general Gini coefficient. We can mention both pre-tax and post-tax. Provide the latest data. Also mention the source. No function call needed.
